items.title: 2.10 Applying Predicate Logic to Real-World Problems

source_refs.note: Topic 2.10 with the Do You Know box, as printed (PDF 32, printed 28).

blocks.text: Predicate logic can be used to solve real-world problems by representing knowledge clearly and systematically. It helps us model situations involving objects, their properties, and relationships. Using predicate logic, we can analyze problems, make decisions, and find solutions logically.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Predicate logic can model family trees, social networks, and even computer programs!
